entries.headline: Six US transports and earlier command-aircraft sightings reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea. It also reported two nuclear command aircraft seen earlier near the US East Coast.

entries.headline: US transports and command aircraft reported; no significant coded traffic
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and United States, along with a nuclear command-and-control aircraft. It said no significant coded broadcasts had been detected that day.

entries.headline: US transports and surveillance aircraft reported over UK and North Sea
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft and a surveillance aircraft airborne over the United Kingdom and North Sea. It identified several as large strategic-airlift cargo aircraft.

entries.headline: Helicopter emergency report repeated; five transports airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel repeated the report that a US Navy helicopter transmitted an emergency code over the Red Sea near Saudi Arabia, saying its status remained unclear. It also reported five large military transport aircraft airborne.

entries.headline: Six US cargo aircraft reported across Atlantic and UK areas
entries.summary: War Watch Intel described US military transport activity as unusually high and reported six large cargo aircraft airborne, including several over the Atlantic and United Kingdom. Its visible post also claimed elevated air activity near Taiwan but did not show the full comparison details.

entries.headline: War Watch relays Al Jazeera report from Russian-occupied Oleshky
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an Al Jazeera-attributed report that people in Russian-occupied Oleshky face hunger, drones and landmines. The visible post does not provide further detail or independent confirmation.

entries.headline: War Watch relays warning concerning UK drone factories
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an Al Jazeera-attributed report that a Kremlin adviser warned UK drone factories could face attacks. The post records the reported warning; it does not establish that any attack occurred.

entries.headline: US transports, helicopter emergency and Eastern Mediterranean activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States, repeated the Navy helicopter emergency-code report near Saudi Arabia, and claimed Eastern Mediterranean air activity was 2.6 times normal. The post does not state the comparison baseline.

entries.headline: US military transports and busy UK/North Sea activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple large US military transport aircraft over the continental United States and described activity near the United Kingdom and North Sea as unusually busy. The post gives no aircraft count or comparison baseline for the latter activity.

entries.headline: Six US transports airborne; earlier helicopter emergency noted
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne over the United States. It also repeated the report of a Navy helicopter transmitting an emergency code over the Red Sea near Saudi Arabia.

entries.headline: US transport, surveillance and nuclear command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel described military aircraft activity over the continental United States as elevated, reporting multiple transport aircraft and a surveillance aircraft airborne alongside a nuclear command jet.

entries.headline: Bombers, surveillance aircraft and transports reported over US
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force bombers, surveillance aircraft and transport jets airborne over the continental United States. Its update also referred to Middle East tensions and the earlier Navy helicopter emergency report near Saudi Arabia.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: P-8 MRNR01 on-ground alert at Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for Australian-registered military P-8 MRNR01 at Burton, Australia. The alert does not establish its preceding activity or mission.

entries.headline: NATO03 E-3 on-ground alert at Geilenkirchen
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for NATO03, a Luxembourg-registered military E-3 Sentry, at Geilenkirchen, Germany. The ground alert does not establish a specific mission.

entries.headline: UK P-8 airborne alert at Lossiemouth
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a UK-registered military P-8 at Lossiemouth, United Kingdom. The callsign appeared as @@@@@@@@; the alert does not confirm its destination or operational purpose.

entries.headline: P-8 BFLO42 airborne alert at Wynyard
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for Australian military P-8 Poseidon BFLO42 at Wynyard, Australia. The alert does not establish its destination or mission.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on Buntar Aerospace funding
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that Ukrainian reconnaissance-drone maker Buntar Aerospace raised $16 million. The post says the funding is intended to scale drone production and battlefield-AI work.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on MICRO-D laser-pod orders
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that a Rafael-linked company received initial orders for its MICRO-D laser-designation pod for unmanned aircraft. The post presents the report's description of the system; it does not independently verify deployment.

entries.headline: P-8 MRNR01 airborne alert at Golden Grove
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for Australian military P-8 Poseidon MRNR01 at Golden Grove, Australia. The alert does not establish its destination or operational purpose.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Port Lincoln
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for an Australian-registered military P-8 at Port Lincoln, Australia. The callsign was shown as NA; no destination or specific mission was established.

entries.headline: P-8 BFLO42 on-ground alert at Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for Australian military P-8 aircraft BFLO42 near Burton, Australia. Its ground status does not establish what activity preceded the alert.

entries.headline: P-8 on-ground alert at Oak Harbor
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for a US-registered military P-8 at Oak Harbor, Washington. The callsign was shown as NA; the alert does not confirm an operational purpose.

entries.headline: Indian P-8 airborne alert near Tiruvallur
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for an Indian military P-8 near Tiruvallur, India. The callsign was shown as NA; no destination or specific mission was established.

entries.headline: P-8 BLKT02 on-ground alert at Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for an Australian military P-8 Poseidon with callsign BLKT02 at Burton, Australia. The alert does not establish the aircraft's mission.
